# Vendored build tools

This directory contains upstream build tooling used to make the Elixir container build reproducible/offline:

- `hex.ez` — Hex 2.2.1 — Apache-2.0.
- `rebar3` — Rebar3 3.24.0 — Apache-2.0.

The Apache-2.0 license text is in `LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt`.

These files are third-party tools, not Curatom-authored code. Rebar3 is distributed here as its upstream self-contained escript and may include bundled upstream components governed by their own notices.
